description:
Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of digital display advertising solutions with the goal of helping our customers find and discover anything they want to buy. We help advertisers reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high-quality sites across the web, and on millions of Kindles, tablets, and mobile devices. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

SDS is part of the Sales Intelligence, Technology, & Enablement organization (SITE). We are a big-data focused engineering team that provides unique, pan-Amazon datasets consolidating advertiser, seller, and vendor KPIs, exposed via data warehousing , fast APIs and agentic soutions. Our data platform is designed to serve Sales teams across WW Advertising orgs for various applications including business processes, ML, account management, marketing, and decisioning systems.



Key job responsibilities
• Design, implement, and support data warehouse / data lake infrastructure using AWS big data stack, Python, Redshift.
• Develop and manage ETLs to source data from various data lakes and create unified data model for analytics and reporting
• Empower technical and non-technical, internal customers to drive their own analytics and reporting (self-serve reporting) and support ad-hoc reporting when needed.
• Develop deep understanding of vast data sources and know exactly how, when, and which data to use to solve particular business problems.
• Manage numerous requests concurrently and strategically, prioritizing when necessary collaborate across teams to deliver results.
• Mentor other engineers, influence positively team culture, and help grow the team.

A day in the life
You will work closely with the Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Managers, Software Development teams and other business stakeholders on many unique business problems and use creative problem solving to deliver actionable output in data gathering, transformation, ingestion and storage. You should be able to gather business and functional requirements and translate these requirements into robust, scalable, operable solutions with a flexible and adaptable data architecture. As a DE, you will be regularly mentoring junior engineerings, developing technical your leadership, and contributing to the design and implementation of highly available, scalable, stable, secure, and cost-effective analytic solutions.

description:
Are you passionate about building data infrastructure that delivers real business value at massive scale? As a Data Engineer at Amazon, you will design, build, and optimize data pipelines and architectures that transform raw data into actionable insights. You will work alongside software engineers, data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to create reliable, performant data solutions that power critical decision-making. This is an opportunity to tackle complex data challenges, shape how information flows across systems, and directly influence outcomes through the quality and accessibility of the data products you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data infrastructure, applying best practices in data quality, lineage tracking, and pipeline monitoring to ensure reliable and performant data delivery.
- Create coherent logical and physical data models that accurately represent business requirements, ensure data integrity and consistency, and drive efficient storage and retrieval across relational and distributed systems.
- Develop and optimize SQL queries and scripts to extract, transform, and manipulate large-scale datasets, leveraging distributed data processing frameworks to handle high-volume workloads efficiently.
- Collaborate with analysts, scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well-architected data solutions, balancing customer needs with long-term technical sustainability.
- Identify opportunities to improve existing data processes — including automating manual operations, enhancing data discoverability, and applying generative AI tools where appropriate to augment productivity and data product quality.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing pipeline health and data quality metrics, then shift into building or refining ETL workflows that serve downstream analytics and machine learning use cases. You might pair with a data scientist to design a new feature dataset, join a design review to evaluate a proposed architecture change, or mentor a teammate on data modeling patterns. You will regularly engage in code reviews, contribute to team planning, and collaborate across functions to keep data solutions aligned with evolving business priorities.

About the team
Our team is committed to making data accessible, reliable, and valuable across Amazon Ads. We build the foundational data infrastructure that enables analysts, scientists, and engineers to make informed decisions at scale. We operate in a collaborative environment where engineers take meaningful ownership of their domains and contribute to shared standards that raise the bar for everyone. If you are excited about solving complex data problems, working with curious and motivated colleagues, and growing your technical impact, we would love to hear from you.

description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a talented Data Engineer to join the Manufacturing Operations, Transportation Operations, and Reverse (MOTOR) organization in support of our Supply Chain Intelligence team. MOTOR manages the manufacturing of datacenter racks and the movement of racks/parts through the supply chain, consisting of transportation, warehousing, and reverse logistics into and out of the data centers. This role performs helps connect the different systems across the supply chain together so operational teams have clean, actionable data to work with. This requires someone with strong analytic skills and business acumen who can work with stakeholders on strategic projects across MOTOR.

The ideal candidate relishes working with large volumes of data, enjoys the challenge of highly complex technical contexts, and, above all else, is passionate about data and analytics. Must be an expert working with data modeling with un/structured data, ingestion pipelines and ETL design and business intelligence tools with the business to identify strategic opportunities where improvements in data infrastructure creates out-sized business impact. Candidate is a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big (while paying careful attention to detail), mentors other engineers in team on high quality tech, and enjoys working in a fast-paced team. Candidate will have a chance to architect the data pipelines needed for optimization and predictive analysis. We're excited to talk to those up to the challenge!



Key job responsibilities
- Build and maintain the infrastructure to answer questions with data, using software engineering best practices, data management fundamentals, data storage principles, recent advances in distributed systems, and operational excellence best practices. Build datasets that analysts and scientists use to generate actionable insights.
- Define the data engineering processes that leverage various AWS services to improve accessibility, redundancy, data integrity, cost, and storage requirements.
- Develop high quality solutions for the faster development of the products/models that solve the business needs in a scalable format, while also anticipating future requirements.
- Collaborate with Research/Applied Scientists, Data Engineers, Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Business Analysts, and Product/Program Managers to understand the business and technical requirements, and make decisions that help make the products/programs smoother.
- Interface with other technology/data engineering teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of data sources using and AWS data technologies.
- Lead the technical design and implementation of the data infrastructure.
- Design and manage data audit, quality, and reconciliation processes in collaboration with various stakeholders.



About the team
This team provides data engineering and business intelligence engineering services to the rest of MOTOR. We are the data experts behind the scenes helping the operational teams focus on operations by ensuring they have accurate, timely data and provide business insights to help improve operational excellence.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Own the data pipelines that let 30K+ AWS data center engineers get trusted, data-backed answers from Eva, our generative AI assistant. You'll lead the move of operational data from manual processes to automated pipelines, dashboards that generate themselves, and knowledge Eva can use the moment someone needs it.

As a Data Engineer II on the Eva Trust team, you'll design, build, and operate the pipelines behind data center analytics. You'll own data domains end to end: you'll ingest data from operational systems, transform and validate it, and publish trusted datasets. Those datasets feed automated dashboards and structured knowledge bases, so insights reach people directly in Eva instead of through manually maintained reports.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and own data pipelines that ingest, transform, and validate data center operational data from multiple source systems
- Lead the migration of manual, high-maintenance data processes and legacy dashboards to automated, monitored pipelines
- Design data models and publish trusted, reusable datasets that power automatically generated dashboards
- Turn curated data into structured knowledge bases and Eva skills so insights show up directly in Eva
- Set and enforce data quality, freshness, and monitoring standards, including alarms and runbooks
- Find and retire brittle or duplicate data dependencies, and improve pipeline reliability and cost
- Work with data center partners to understand their data sources and needs, then turn ambiguous asks into clear plans
- Write clean, tested, documented code, take part in design and code reviews, and mentor junior engineers and interns

A day in the life
You might start the day reviewing pipeline health and deciding how to fix a recurring freshness issue at its source. Then you meet a data center operations partner to plan how a widely used dashboard's data moves into Eva. In the afternoon you write the design for a new ingestion pipeline, review a junior engineer's code, and work with the Eva platform team on how a new knowledge base plugs in. You finish by checking Eva's answers against your published data.

About the team
Eva Trust is part of the Data Center Gen AI team in AWS Infrastructure Services. We make sure Eva, the AI assistant used by 30K+ people across the data center community, is accurate, safe, and trusted, and that it brings up the right information where people need it. We own the data pipelines, dashboards, structured knowledge, evaluations, and guardrails behind Eva. We combine deep data center domain expertise with data and AI engineering, and we invest in growing the people around us.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
